test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct active voice of the given sentence.**

The states of Maharashtra and Gujarat have been alerted about the impending cyclone by NDRF.

options.text: NDRF has alerted the states of Maharashtra and Gujarat about the impending cyclone.
NDRF alerted the states of Maharashtra and Gujarat about the impending cyclone.
NDRF was alerting the states of Maharashtra and Gujarat about the impending cyclone.
NDRF has been alerting the states of Maharashtra and Gujarat about the impending cyclone.

solution:
The correct answer is: **NDRF has alerted the states of Maharashtra and Gujarat about the impending cyclone. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and in the Present Perfect tense.
 
• The Present Perfect in the passive voice has the following form: Object + has/have + been + past participle (V3) + (by + subject)__
 
• The Present Perfect in the active voice has the following form: __Subject + has/have + past participle (V3) + object__
 __
 
• Passive: *The photo has been clicked by the photographer.*
 
• Active: *The photographer has clicked the photo.*
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the Subject into the object.
 
• In the case of the Present Perfect tense, '**been**' should be used after have/has in the passive voice.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct Active Voice:__ *NDRF has alerted the states of Maharashtra and Gujarat about the impending cyclone. *
